visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable views, including a curated 1024×640 preview. The turquoise sixteen-point folded umbrella has warm pale ribs and a pale underside over the sixteen-sided hall. Low mapped ranges carry repeated shallow white caps and open columns. The tall square minaret has a projecting platform and pleated pointed cap. Corrected the approach treads so they descend outside the podium and lowered the hall camera to show its original coarse diamond screen rhythm and wood-colored door. Screens, roof caps, ribs, tower subdivisions and facade spacing simplify the photographed exterior. Fine star-screen artwork, lettering, fixtures, gardens, reflecting pools and furnished interiors are omitted.

fidelityReview.notes: Individual medium-fi National Mosque of Malaysia campus: broad turquoise sixteen-point folded umbrella roof, pale rib bands and sixteen-sided hall, low mapped roof ranges with repeated shallow white square caps, open colonnades and courts, raised entry canopy and tall square pale minaret with pleated pointed cap. Exact three map controls retained; internal roof/hall layout, facade rhythms and component heights remain estimates except current 11 m main and 73 m tower total tags. Five existing shared 256² graphs serve six merged material roles. Four separate browser LODs. No bespoke photography, inscriptions, fine screen artwork, neighboring mausoleum/ranges or furnished interiors. Current main building height tag is 11 m; current tower height tag is 73 m; the connector has layer=1 and no height. Retained main building has three levels and no numeric height. Main low roofs use 11 m above the working floor. Picture estimates: raised podium 2.4 m; sixteen-sided prayer hall eaves 11 m; folded umbrella valleys 11.5 m, projecting tips 15.3 m and central hub 26 m. The blue roof therefore rises above the coarse main building height tag, explicitly reconstructed from pictures. Tower total height respects 73 m, with estimated slender square shaft to 56 m, projecting square platform to 59 m and pleated pointed white cap/finial to 73 m. The 73 m tag does not establish those internal levels. Entry stairs, canopy fingers, roof caps and lattice proportions are approximate; no surveyed engineering or interior claim. Two useful actually inspected Commons overall photographs plus one supplementary screen detail guide the exterior. Main height 11 m, tower height 73 m and connector layer 1 are current map facts. The taller folded roof, hall center and all internal tower tiers are estimates. The original retained main facts and signed axes remain unchanged. Three raw building outlines establish placement and scale; they do not establish the exact internal cap grid, colonnade spacing, entry approach or roof geometry. The standard DEM is coarse and the source fixture seats a working floor. Exact finish, structural engineering, unseen interiors and physical phone/tablet/laptop performance remain unverified.
